title: Pre-shading of ballots during BARMM poll ‘not limited’ to Maluso—watchdog
summary: The pre-shading of ballots during the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary poll was “not limited” to Maluso, Basilan, a watchdog said on Wednesday.
